idea.title: 5 reasons your listing gets no DMs
idea.angle: The listing isn't bad, it's invisible: photo dump, no hook, hidden basics, a weak next step and posting once. Fix the packaging before you look for more listings.
idea.hook: 5 REASONS YOUR LISTING GETS NO DMS

slides.heading: 5 REASONS YOUR LISTING GETS **NO DMS**
slides.body: It's not the house. It's how you post it.

slides.heading: YOUR LISTING ISN'T BAD. IT'S **INVISIBLE**.
slides.body: You don't need more listings. You need the ones you have to get noticed. These five things stop that.

slides.heading: THE PHOTO **DUMP**
slides.body: Twenty photos in random order, gate first. Buyers decide in about a second. Lead with your best shot.

slides.heading: NO **HOOK**
slides.body: Nothing says why this home is worth their time. Open with the area, the size or the standout feature.

slides.heading: HIDDEN **BASICS**
slides.body: No price, no location, no bedroom count. People who have to ask for the basics often don't bother.

slides.heading: NO CLEAR **NEXT STEP**
slides.body: "DM for more info" is weak. Give buyers one simple action, like a keyword or a WhatsApp link.

slides.heading: POSTED **ONCE**, IN ONE PLACE
slides.body: One Instagram post, then silence. Most of your audience never sees it. Share it in more places, and repost.

caption:
Your listing isn't bad. It's just not getting noticed.

Most listings get no messages for the same five reasons: a photo dump, no hook, hidden basics, no clear next step, and posting once.
The fix isn't more money on ads.
It's packaging the same listing so buyers notice it, understand it and act on it.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.

idea.title: Post layout: photo dump vs a post that sells
idea.angle: Before: a grid of random photos, gate first, no text. After: hero shot with a hook line, rooms in the order that sells, basics on a slide, one keyword at the end. Shown as a simple layout, no real photos.
idea.hook: SAME LISTING. TWO POSTS. SPOT THE DIFFERENCE.

slides.heading: SAME LISTING. TWO POSTS. SPOT THE **DIFFERENCE**.
slides.body: Same photos. A new layout.

slides.heading: MOST LISTING POSTS LOOK **THE SAME**
slides.body: A grid of random photos. The gate first. No words. Nothing tells the buyer why they should stop.

slides.heading: THE **FIRST** PHOTO
slides.body:
Before: The gate, or a blurry corridor. No words.
After:
✓ Your single best shot first
✓ One bold line on top
✓ "4-bed with pool, quiet street"
✓ Buyers know why to stop

slides.heading: THE **ORDER**
slides.body:
Before: Random rooms. Kitchen, then garden, then a bathroom.
After:
✓ Living room, then kitchen
✓ Master bedroom and bathroom
✓ Other bedrooms
✓ Standout feature, then the area

slides.heading: THE **BASICS**
slides.body:
Before: No details. Buyers have to ask, and many don't.
After:
✓ Bedrooms and bathrooms
✓ For sale or for rent
✓ Three highlights
✓ Price and location

slides.heading: THE **ENDING**
slides.body:
Before: "DM for more info." Or three ways to contact you.
After:
✓ One keyword, like TOUR
✓ Or one WhatsApp link
✓ A new keyword per listing
✓ Never three options

slides.heading: You don't need a new shoot. You need a better **layout**.
slides.body: Same photos. Now buyers notice it and understand it.

caption:
Same listing. Same photos. One post gets ignored, the other gets messages.

The difference is the layout, not the house.
Lead with your best shot and one bold line.
Show the rooms in order, put the basics where buyers can see them, and end with one keyword.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.

idea.title: The order that sells: 8 photos in sequence
idea.angle: Order is a story: hero shot, living room, kitchen, master bedroom, master bathroom, other bedrooms, standout feature, neighbourhood. Same photos, clearer listing.
idea.hook: POST YOUR PHOTOS IN THIS ORDER

slides.heading: POST YOUR PHOTOS IN **THIS ORDER**
slides.body: Same photos. A clearer listing.

slides.heading: RANDOM PHOTOS GET BUYERS **LOST**
slides.body: Gate, bathroom, kitchen, garden. The buyer can't picture the home, so they stop swiping. Order turns your photos into a story.

slides.heading: LEAD WITH YOUR **HERO** SHOT
slides.body: Your single most impressive photo, even if it's not the front. That shot is your hook.

slides.heading: THEN THE **LIVING** SPACES
slides.body: Living room first, then the kitchen. Walk them in the way you would on a viewing.

slides.heading: THEN THE **BEDROOMS**
slides.body: Master bedroom, then the master bathroom. Then the other bedrooms.

slides.heading: FINISH WITH THE **EXTRAS**
slides.body: Your standout feature, like a pool, a view or a garden. Then the neighbourhood or a nearby landmark.

slides.heading: THE ORDER **AT A GLANCE**
bullets: Open: hero shot, living room, kitchen.
End: standout feature, then the neighbourhood.

slides.heading: SAME PHOTOS. **CLEARER** LISTING.
slides.body: Save this before you post your next listing

caption:
The photos you already have can sell better. Just change the order.

Lead with your hero shot, even if it's not the front.
Then walk buyers through the home: living room, kitchen, bedrooms.
End with the standout feature and the neighbourhood.

Save this before you post your next listing.

idea.title: Your first WhatsApp reply: 4 things to send
idea.angle: A slow 'yes it's available' wastes the buyer's interest. A strong first reply confirms the listing, shares the key basics, asks one question and offers a viewing time.
idea.hook: SEND THESE 4 THINGS IN YOUR FIRST REPLY

slides.heading: YOUR FIRST REPLY NEEDS **4 THINGS**
slides.body: Not just "Yes, it's available."

slides.heading: "YES, IT'S AVAILABLE" IS **NOT ENOUGH**
slides.body: It answers one question and starts ten more. A buyer who waits hours has usually messaged three other agents by then.

slides.heading: CONFIRM THE **LISTING**
slides.body: Name the home, so they know you mean the right one. "Yes, the 4-bed with the pool is available."

slides.heading: SHARE THE **BASICS**
slides.body: Bedrooms, bathrooms, price and area. Answer what they were about to ask next.

slides.heading: ASK **ONE** QUESTION
slides.body: Just one, to keep the chat going. "When are you hoping to move?"

slides.heading: OFFER A **VIEWING** TIME
slides.body: Don't ask "When are you free?" Offer a slot: "I can show you Saturday at 10. Does that work?"

slides.heading: ONE REPLY, NOT **TEN**
slides.body:
Before: "Yes, it's available."
After: Yes, the 4-bed with the pool is available.
4 bed · 3 bath · [Price] · [Area]
When are you hoping to move?
I can show you Saturday at 10.

slides.heading: REPLY ONCE. BOOK THE **VIEWING**.
slides.body: Save this and use it in your next reply

caption:
"Yes, it's available" is not a reply. It's a delay.

A strong first reply does four things.
It confirms the listing and shares the basics.
It asks one question and offers a viewing time.
One good message beats ten slow ones.

Save this and use it in your next reply.

idea.title: The 15-second listing video formula
idea.angle: Short videos reach far more people than photo posts. The formula: 0-3 seconds hook, 3-12 seconds tour of four or five spaces, 12-15 seconds the ask with one clear action.

slides.heading: THE **15-SECOND** VIDEO THAT GETS DMS
slides.body: Three parts. Hook, tour, ask.

slides.heading: NOBODY FINISHES A **SLOW** VIDEO
slides.body: Long walk-throughs lose people before the best room. Yet short videos reach far more people than photo posts. So keep it short.

slides.heading: 0-3 SECONDS: THE **HOOK**
slides.body: Your best shot with bold text on screen. Like: "4-bed with pool, quiet street."

slides.heading: 3-12 SECONDS: THE **TOUR**
slides.body: Four or five of your best spaces, in the order that sells. Slow, smooth moves. Two to three seconds each.

slides.heading: 12-15 SECONDS: THE **ASK**
slides.body: Price, location and one clear action. "DM TOUR to book a viewing."

slides.heading: THE **PREMIUM** DETAILS
bullets: Light: bright and warm. Dark rooms look small.
Captions: big enough to read with the sound off.
Music: calm for luxury, upbeat for apartments.
Nothing fake: no added furniture, rooms or views.

slides.heading: No time to film? Your **photos** are enough.
slides.body: AI can turn the listing photos you already have into a smooth video. No camera crew. No reshoot.

caption:
Your listing video doesn't need to be long. It needs to be 15 seconds.

0-3 seconds: your best shot with bold text.
3-12 seconds: four or five of your best spaces, two to three seconds each.
12-15 seconds: price, location and one clear action.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.

idea.title: 4 photo mistakes that make homes look cheap
idea.angle: Dark rooms, tilted walls, clutter (buckets, wires, clothes) and shooting from the middle of the room all make a good home look small and cheap. Each has a simple fix.
idea.hook: 4 PHOTO MISTAKES THAT MAKE HOMES LOOK CHEAP

slides.kicker: FOR AGENTS WHO SHOOT ON A PHONE
slides.heading: 4 MISTAKES THAT MAKE HOMES LOOK **CHEAP**
slides.body: Good homes. Bad photos. Simple fixes.

slides.heading: IT'S NOT THE HOME. IT'S THE **PHOTOS**.
slides.body: Buyers judge the home by your photos. Same phone, a few new habits, and the same home looks its best.

slides.heading: **DARK** ROOMS
slides.body: Dark rooms look small and unloved. Fix: shoot in daylight, curtains open, lights on. Late morning usually gives the most even light.

slides.heading: **TILTED** WALLS
slides.body: Tilted walls make a home look cheap. Fix: hold the phone straight, at chest height.

slides.heading: **CLUTTER** IN THE SHOT
slides.body: Buckets, wires, clothes, anything personal. Fix: clear the room before you shoot, not after.

slides.heading: SHOOTING FROM THE **MIDDLE**
slides.body: The room looks smaller than it is. Fix: shoot from the corner, so the room looks open and true to size.

slides.heading: Make it look good. Keep it **honest**.
slides.body: Never edit the layout. Buyers who feel misled don't come back.

slides.heading: SHOOT IT **RIGHT** NEXT TIME
slides.body: Save this for your next listing shoot

caption:
Most homes don't look cheap. Their photos do.

Dark rooms, tilted walls, clutter and shooting from the middle of the room.
Each one has a simple fix, and you can use the same phone.
Daylight, phone straight, clear the room, shoot from the corner.

Save this for your next listing shoot.
